statement.zh: 三星堆为商王朝殖民前哨的说法仍属假说，不为祭祀区新发现自动证明。
statement.en: The claim that Sanxingdui was a Shang colonial outpost remains a hypothesis and is not automatically proven by new sacrificial-area finds.

disclaimer: This record is a HYPOTHESIS / contested scholarly reading, not an established archaeological conclusion. Do not treat as fact.
